_note: Which model made each arm's reviews, declared rather than inferred (#1058, #1097). A new arm is invisible to the corpus until it is written down here, which is the recurrence the first version of the test did not prevent: #1058's drift was uniform within each arm and different between them. Pass 'a' is {P}_review.yaml, pass 'b' is {P}_review_b.yaml; a 'b' under a different model is the point of a paired pass, not a violation.

undated_reviews._note: Reviews with no reviewed_at. The claim #1058 rests on is that the reviewer changed over time, so a review with no time cannot support it and must be listed rather than tolerated silently. The time is recoverable from git — the file was committed in 26e44caf on 2026-08-31 — but a recovered time is a different claim from a recorded one and would need its basis stated the way backfilled prompt hashes do (#399), so it is left absent.
